messages:
Leila Morgan: Quick capture from today's all-hands Q&A re: customer wins/losses and the follow-up asks for leadership.

Arjun Rao: Key patterns: wins = burst stability + clear cost reporting; losses = BYO-KMS gaps and lack of on-prem reference for air-gapped customers.

Kelsey Park: CS note: procurement teams repeatedly request exportable audit logs + per-team billing tags. Without that, they stall legal.

Danielle Ortiz: Also saw requests for a Console feature: an automated eval gate that blocks rollouts when core prompts regress. Customers called this a "must-have" for production safety.

Arjun Rao: Leadership Q: which of these are Q1 musts? My vote: 1) BYO-KMS in VPC + audit export (Q1), 2) Eval-gate prototype in Console (Q1 prototype), 3) On-prem minimal reference (Q2).

infra-bot: Infra blockers summary: INF-841 (KMS proxy auth), INF-842 (audit-stream reliability), INF-853 (VPC peering automation). All triaged; rough ETA 4-7w if prioritized.

Leila Morgan: Sales/CS ask: a one-pager "what we support today vs roadmap" to hand to prospects. They need it in 5 business days.

Kelsey Park: Action items I captured: 1) PM draft one-pager by next Wed; 2) Infra reply with blockers + ETA by Thu EOD; 3) DevEx publish canary + prefix-caching examples this week; 4) Ops build tiny on-prem ref spec for early Q2.

Danielle Ortiz: Quick wins to unblock deals: publish recommended canary percentages, add SDK sample for prefix caching, and a short FAQ on current KMS/support status.

Arjun Rao: Leadership ask: confirm priority order and whether to allocate 1-2 infra engineers to accelerate INF-841/842. If yes, we'll update customers with firm timelines.

Leila Morgan: I'll present the headcount request to Exec and report back by Fri. Drop any anonymized customer quotes here for the one-pager.

Kelsey Park: Quote (anonymized): "We need customer-managed keys + audit export to proceed with procurement."

Leila Morgan: Thanks all. I'll post a short summary + action tracker in #product after infra replies.

Arjun Rao: :thumbsup:

Danielle Ortiz: End of thread - will follow up in #sales-docs when one-pager draft is ready.
